blocks.text: The Preston Outdoor Wall Lantern combines a sleek black finish, clear glass shade, and round back plate for a clean, versatile look that complements both modern and traditional exteriors. Crafted from durable steel with a waterproof seal and treated to protect against pitting, and discoloration to deliver long-lasting performance. Ideal for lighting entryways, patios, garages, pathways, and garden walls, it extends 5.75 inches from the wall, measures 4.75 inches wide by 8 inches high, and accommodates one medium-base 60W incandescent or 12W LED bulb (bulb not included). Easy to install with included mounting hardware and cULus certified for wet locations, the Preston offers dependable, stylish illumination backed by a 1-year warranty.

items.label: BRIGHTEN YOUR OUTDOOR AREAS
items.value: The clear glass works with the sharp lines and rounded back plate to provide a clean looking aesthetic perfect for complementing a wide range of house settings, and our sconce lanterns are treated to prevent pitting, tarnishing, and discoloration so that they will provide welcoming and safe lighting for years to come

items.label: VERSATILE PLACEMENT
items.value: Perfect for a wide range of modern and rustic home settings, our outdoor scones are perfect for adding a touch of elegance and sophistication to your front door, patio, garage, entryway or pathway area. Works with optional dimmable bulb (not included)

items.label: EASY INSTALLATION
items.value: This outdoor sconce includes mounting hardware to allow for quick and easy installation, and the outside light fixture also allows for easy bulb replacement

items.label: BUILT TO LAST
items.value: Our wall sconces are constructed with a strong and sturdy steel construction and a clear glass shade for maximum outdoor illumination and long-lasting reliable lighting; our wall sconce lights feature a waterproof seal and are designed to stand up to harsh outdoor weather elements

items.label: SPECS
items.value: Our lighting fixtures extend 5.75 inches from the wall, and measure 4.75 W x 8 H in inches, and are suitable for use with one medium-base incandescent 60W max bulb or 12W LED bulb (Bulbs not included); cULus certified for installation and use in wet exterior areas

items.value: All products purchased have a 30-day replacement parts policy to ensure a fully working item. All products are covered under a 1-year warranty when purchased on amazon. The warranty period begins on the day the product is originally shipped. The warranty covers all of the items and conditions identified in the original manufacturers warranty. Some of the items specifically not covered by the warranty are loss and theft, water damage, customer abuse, and finish detoriation due to uv or coastal exposure.
